points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in document-level QA for aerospace applications.

\item Built YOLO-based object detection system for National ID authentication, achieving robust counterfeit hologram detection across varied designs using transfer learning and GAN-generated synthetic samples.
\item Optimized computer vision pipeline by eliminating redundant processing, reducing per-card detection time from 7 minutes to 3 minutes while maintaining 95%+ accuracy.
\item Developed ML-based anomaly detection system for MFA workflows using TensorFlow, reducing redundant verification prompts by 25% while maintaining security coverage.
\item Containerized and deployed production ML solutions using Docker and AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2), ensuring scalable pipelines for identity verification and anomaly detection systems.
\item Applied transfer learning techniques to fine-tune pre-trained models (YOLO, MiDaS) for limited datasets, achieving production-ready performance on edge cases.
